runDescription: Choose the agent and optional project for this one run. Routine defaults are prefilled and won't be changed.
agentRequired: Default agent required for this run.
chooseWorkspace: Choose an existing workspace before running.
detected: Detected from `{{placeholder}}` placeholders in the title and instructions.
prompt: Prompt the user for this value before each manual run.
label: Label
hint: Use `{{placeholder}}` placeholders in the title or instructions to prompt for inputs when the routine runs.
helpDescription: How to prompt for inputs and which variables Paperclip fills in automatically.
customDescription: Type {{placeholder}} anywhere in the title or instructions. Paperclip detects each placeholder, lists it under Variables, and prompts for a value before each run.
namesHelp: Names must start with a letter and may use letters, numbers, and underscores.
typesHelp: Pick a type (text, textarea, number, boolean, select, date), default value, and whether it is required.
dateHelp: Variable names ending in capital Date, such as startDate, are created as date variables by default.
reuseHelp: The same name reused across the title and instructions is treated as one variable.
builtInHelp: These are filled in automatically — no setup needed and they will not appear in the Variables list.
dateDescription: Current date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC) at the time the routine runs.
timestampDescription: Human-readable date and time (UTC) at the time the routine runs.
conflict: Routine changed elsewhere. Reload to merge.
overwriteHelp: Replaces the newer revision with your local edits.
discardDescription_one: This will revert {{count}} unsaved change in this section.
discardDescription_other: This will revert {{count}} unsaved changes in this section.
readOnly: Read-only — you don't own this routine.
